title: Variations side by side in the Story detail
description: Each variation leads with its point and the things it connects to. Accept or Reject with a reason box, no dropdowns, Lucide icons, full screen on a phone. Accepting carries the wording onto the Story as a new version. Ryan reviews screenshots before merge.

comments.author: home
comments.text: From the consultation: on accept, record which variation a Story version came from (variationId). Decide what accepting a second variation means for the first, since it goes back to offered though its wording is in version history.
